title: Avicularin and Senegenin Suppress TRPV3-Associated TSLP Expression in Human Keratinocytes.
authors: Kim, Han Bi; Um, Ji Young; Song, Da Eun; Chung, Bo Young; Park, Chun Wook; Kim, Hye One
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物对TRPV3通道及TSLP表达的抑制，涉及钙信号和NFAT/NF-κB通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Transient receptor potential vanilloid channel 3 (TRPV3) is a keratinocyte-expressed ion channel that regulates calcium signaling and thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP) production, contributing to pruritic inflammatory skin diseases. Although avicularin (AVC), a flavonoid from Polygonum aviculare L., and senegenin (SNG), the bioactive aglycone of Polygala tenuifolia Willd., possess anti-inflammatory properties, their effects on TRPV3-associated signaling remain unknown. A natural product library was screened for nitric oxide (NO) production in carvacrol-stimulated human keratinocytes. Following primary screening and secondary evaluation of TRPV3 and TSLP expression, AVC and SNG were selected for further study and subsequently evaluated by molecular docking, calcium imaging, quantitative real-time PCR, immunocytochemistry, and pathway inhibition assays. AVC and SNG showed favorable predicted docking poses at both TRPV3 docking sites and significantly attenuated carvacrol-induced calcium-dependent fluorescence responses in TRPV3-expressing cells. Both compounds reduced TRPV3 and TSLP expression at the mRNA and protein levels and attenuated the nuclear translocation of phospho-Nuclear Factor of Activated T Cells 2 (NFATC2) and phospho-p50. Co-treatment with NFAT or Nuclear Factor Kappa B (NF-kappaB) inhibitors produced no additional suppression, consistent with convergence of AVC/SNG-associated effects with NFAT/NF-kappaB signaling. Collectively, these findings support further investigation of AVC and SNG as candidate modulators of TRPV3-associated inflammatory signaling in keratinocytes.
abstract_zh: 瞬时受体电位香草酸通道3（TRPV3）是一种在角质形成细胞中表达的离子通道，调节钙信号传导和胸腺基质淋巴细胞生成素（TSLP）的产生，参与瘙痒性炎症性皮肤病。尽管扁蓄苷（AVC），一种来自萹蓄（Polygonum aviculare L.）的黄酮类化合物，以及远志皂苷元（SNG），远志（Polygala tenuifolia Willd.）的生物活性苷元，具有抗炎特性，但它们对TRPV3相关信号传导的影响仍不清楚。本研究筛选了一个天然产物库，检测其在香芹酚刺激的人角质形成细胞中一氧化氮（NO）的产生。经过初步筛选和TRPV3及TSLP表达的二次评估，选择AVC和SNG进行进一步研究，并通过分子对接、钙成像、实时定量PCR、免疫细胞化学和通路抑制实验进行评估。AVC和SNG在TRPV3的两个对接位点均显示出良好的预测对接构象，并显著减弱了表达TRPV3的细胞中香芹酚诱导的钙依赖性荧光反应。这两种化合物在mRNA和蛋白质水平上均降低了TRPV3和TSLP的表达，并减弱了磷酸化活化T细胞核因子2（NFATC2）和磷酸化p50的核转位。与NFAT或核因子κB（NF-kappaB）抑制剂联合处理未产生额外的抑制作用，这与AVC/SNG相关效应与NFAT/NF-kappaB信号传导的汇聚一致。总体而言，这些发现支持进一步研究AVC和SNG作为角质形成细胞中TRPV3相关炎症信号传导的候选调节剂。
